name: TaskFlow - AI-Powered Project Manager
description: An intelligent project management platform that leverages AI to automate task creation, prioritization, and team collaboration.

features.name: Natural Language Task Creation
features.description: Users describe tasks in plain language; AI creates structured tasks with labels, estimates, and dependencies.

sub_tasks.name: System prompt for task parsing
sub_tasks.reasoning: Single-turn task extraction from natural language input

sub_tasks.name: Context-aware task enrichment
sub_tasks.reasoning: Needs project context to assign labels, estimate effort, and link dependencies. Multiple rounds for refinement.

sub_tasks.name: Validation and error handling
sub_tasks.reasoning: Generating validation logic with edge cases. High iteration count for bug fixing.

features.name: Smart Task Prioritization
features.description: AI analyzes task dependencies, deadlines, and team capacity to suggest optimal ordering.

sub_tasks.name: Dependency graph analysis
sub_tasks.reasoning: Complex graph traversal and conflict resolution requiring deep reasoning

features.name: Meeting Summary Generator
features.description: Transcribes and summarizes meetings, extracting action items and decisions.

sub_tasks.name: Transcript chunking and summarization
sub_tasks.reasoning: Long meeting transcripts require chunked processing. Async-friendly — ideal for batch API.

sub_tasks.name: Action item extraction
sub_tasks.reasoning: Structured extraction of tasks, owners, and deadlines from summary

features.name: Code Review Assistant
features.description: Reviews PRs and suggests improvements, catching bugs and style issues.

sub_tasks.name: Static analysis and pattern matching
sub_tasks.reasoning: Large PR diffs with shared context across PRs — prompt caching yields 60% input savings

features.name: Documentation Generator
features.description: Generates API docs, README files, and inline comments from code.

sub_tasks.name: API endpoint documentation
sub_tasks.reasoning: High output volume for comprehensive docs with examples

sub_tasks.name: README generation
sub_tasks.reasoning: Standard content generation with moderate context

features.name: Data Migration Scripts
features.description: Generates ETL scripts from schema descriptions and migration specifications.

sub_tasks.name: Schema diff analysis
sub_tasks.reasoning: Complex schema comparison and migration path reasoning

sub_tasks.name: ETL script generation
sub_tasks.reasoning: High output volume, multiple iterations for correctness

features.name: Sentiment Analysis Dashboard
features.description: Analyzes team communication sentiment across Slack, email, and comments.

sub_tasks.name: Message classification pipeline
sub_tasks.reasoning: High volume, low per-call cost — fast model preferred

sub_tasks.name: Trend aggregation and insights
sub_tasks.reasoning: Periodic batch analysis of aggregated sentiment data

features.name: Multi-language Support
features.description: Translates UI strings and content to 5 languages with context awareness.

sub_tasks.name: UI string batch translation
sub_tasks.reasoning: 5 target languages, batch processing — translation models excel here

sub_tasks.name: Context-aware content translation
sub_tasks.reasoning: Richer context needed for dynamic content with domain terminology
